validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: beyond doubt. Atlantic Bridge Project Phase II is the second tranche of the FERC-certificated Atlantic Bridge Project (Docket No. CP16-9-000; pre-filing docket PF15-12-000 opened January 30, 2015), completing the expansion of Algonquin Gas Transmission, LLC's system into New England with the Weymouth Compressor Station. CLASSIFICATION: 'transmission'/'Gas' is correct. DUPLICATE/CLUSTER CHECK (roster scan per the cluster warning): sibling P7820 'Atlantic Bridge Project Phase I' (40 MMcf/d, in-service Nov 2017) is a separate, distinct segment of the same certificated project - correctly a separate row, not a duplicate. P0144 (Access Northeast, cancelled) and P6011 (Project Maple, proposed 2023) are separate Algonquin/Enbridge New England expansion proposals, physically and temporally distinct from Atlantic Bridge. System rows P0149/P0150 (the whole Algonquin/Maritimes & Northeast system) are out of this row's scope. SPEC CONCERN (value swap with sibling P7820, independently confirmed from this row's own research and cross-checked against P7820's own shard, which flagged the mirror-image error and filed a cross_row_lead here): GEM records LengthKnown=0.00/Diameter=blank on P7821, but every source checked shows P7821 (Phase II) is the tranche that included 6.3 miles of new 42-inch pipe, while P7820 (Phase I) added zero new pipe. EIA's Natural Gas Pipeline Projects dataset is consistent across every dated release from 2019-01 through 2026-08 (Aug-2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 1014): project_name='Atlantic Bridge Project Phase 2', operator='Algonquin Gas Transmission' (confirmed as a properly-scoped, non-aggregate row - EIA carries a SEPARATE 'Phase 2 (CAN)' row for the Maritimes & Northeast/Canadian portion, proving EIA itself splits this project by segment rather than reporting one portfolio total), miles=6.3, pipeline_diameter_inches=42, additional_capacity_mmcf_d=93, cost_millions=451.8. This independently and exactly matches the Federal Register's Notice of Availability of the Environmental Assessment (FR Doc. 2016-10674, docket CP16-9-000, published 2016-05-06 - itself a docket-specific primary document, not a portfolio total): '4.0 miles of 42-inch-diameter pipeline to replace existing 26-inch diameter pipeline in Westchester County, New York; 2.3 miles of 42-inch-diameter pipeline to replace existing 26-inch diameter pipeline in Fairfield County, Connecticut' = 4.0 + 2.3 = 6.3 miles of 42-inch pipe, EXACTLY matching EIA's Phase 2 figure via a completely independent document/publisher chain (FERC/Federal Register vs. EIA). This is corroborated operationally: P7821's own already-recorded SegmentCost=451,800,000 USD already matches EIA's Phase 2 cost_millions=451.8 exactly, and its own StartYear1=2021/StartMonth1=1 matches Enbridge's FY2020 10-K (SEC EDGAR accession 0000895728-21-000010): 'the third and final phase of Atlantic Bridge fully commenced service in January 2021 with the Weymouth compressor station being brought online' - i.e. this row already carries the correct cost and start date for the phase that included the 6.3 mi/42-inch pipe; only LengthKnown/Diameter are wrong, and they are wrong in the direction of P7820's own erroneous 6.00 mi (a clean two-row value swap, not two independent errors). Per rule 4(e) and the Equitrans-precedent scope warning: no portfolio/aggregate total has been used here as a per-segment source - EIA's Phase 2 row and the FERC EA's facility list are both scoped to this specific 6.3-mile construction, not to the combined ~133 mmcf/d project.
